product.title: Mega Yacht ALL INCLUSIVE Yelapa Waterfall & Snorkeling Adventure

description.text: In Puerto Vallarta, this all-inclusive mega-yacht day sails Banderas Bay toward Playa Chica Locca, Quimixto, and Yelapa Beach. Breakfast, a fajita lunch, snacks, and an open bar are served on board, with snorkeling gear, kayaks, and paddleboards ready after the first anchor. A short trail hike to the Yelapa waterfall is available when water is flowing, with free time in the village or a massage back on the yacht. Two meeting places are listed at booking so the group can board at the more convenient dock, including Puerto Mágico. The format suits visitors who want a guided scenic day on the water without chartering a boat independently. Departures are confirmed at booking in Puerto Vallarta, and the itinerary stays on the published bay, beach, and village stops rather than adding extra mainland sightseeing.

highlights: Cruise to Yelapa and Yelapa Waterfalls aboard a comfortable yacht
Get set up with the use of snorkeling equipment, kayaks, and paddleboards
Gain access to a premium onboard open bar for alcoholic drinks
Breakfast, lunch, and snacks are included so you don’t have to worry

start.description: Check in at the Chica Locca Tours office at Puerto Mágico Cruise Ship Terminal, or the alternate meeting place chosen when booking.

end.description: Return to your Puerto Vallarta meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
